name: Moonkeeper Sentinel Vault
introDiscord: An ancient Moonkeeper vault recognizes your approach and begins waking up whether you asked it to or not. Runes flash, doors unlock, and dormant Sentinels receive the worst notification imaginable: a visitor.
introTwitch: An ancient Moonkeeper vault recognizes your approach and begins waking up whether you asked it to or not. Runes flash, doors unlock, and dormant Sentinels receive the worst notification imaginable: a visitor.

keeper-seal.prompt: The Keeper Seal flashes awake across three vault doors. Catalog runes begin counting your belongings while an armored niche quietly unlocks.

left.message: A Moonkeeper Sentinel steps from its niche, scans you, checks a glowing rune, scans you again, and somehow becomes even less satisfied.

right.message: Shizuki's Keeper-root medicine reads: "Hidden from Sentinels and anyone fond of inventories. If you're reading this, congratulations on ignoring both."
right.fullHpMessage: The Keeper-root medicine remains hidden. You are already at full health, and the inventory can remain blissfully inaccurate.

forward.message: A moon-shell coffer remains catalogued inside a storage recess. The inventory slate still says 'DO NOT REMOVE.' You remove Star Candies.

vigil-corridor.prompt: Silent armor niches line the corridor. Some are empty. Some are definitely not. Three routes continue beneath runes displaying increasingly stern warnings.

left.message: A Fae vessel has apparently been sitting in evidence storage for centuries. Its offense is listed only as 'UNAUTHORIZED WHIMSY.' You free it and find Star Candies.

right.message: One supposedly empty armor niche closes behind you. That is the exact moment its Sentinel steps out.

forward.message: Shizuki turned an old broken insignia into a Berry cache. Her note reads: "Much better use for official symbols."

oathbound-gallery.prompt: Ancient reliefs depict generations of Moonkeepers taking ceremonial vows. Three doors remain unlabeled, presumably because everyone who worked here already knew where they went. Helpful.

left.message: Shizuki's bottle reads: "Old guardians watch doors. Clever wanderers watch reflections. Very clever wanderers leave before the door notices."
left.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's door-watching remedy remains unused. At full health, you can concentrate on leaving before the door notices.

right.message: A Moonkeeper cache requires an authorization sigil. The sigil is still inserted in the lock. Whoever designed this security system had tremendous faith in workplace honesty. Inside: Star Candies.

forward.message: The final Sentinel does not scan you. It has apparently received enough information already.

boss-antechamber.name: Eternal Watchroom
boss-antechamber.prompt: The vault's deepest chamber is lined with ancient armor niches and one uninterrupted watch-rune. Every suit faces the oldest station at the center.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every dormant armor niche activates at once—then kneels.

The Watchroom's oldest suit of armor moves for the first time in centuries.

A single rune flashes:

WATCH CONTINUES.

Use /yes to challenge the Moonkeeper Eternal or /no to let it continue watching somebody else.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every dormant armor niche activates at once—then kneels.

The Watchroom's oldest suit of armor moves for the first time in centuries.

A single rune flashes:

WATCH CONTINUES.

Use !yes to challenge the Moonkeeper Eternal or !no to let it continue watching somebody else.
bossRetreatText: You leave the Eternal Watchroom to its vigil. The ancient armor settles back while WATCH CONTINUES glows behind you.

boss.revealText: Ancient armor locks into place around a brilliant watch-rune. The Moonkeeper Eternal resumes its vigil!

completionText: The Moonkeeper Eternal returns to its station. A nearby rune changes from INTRUDER to TRAVELER. That is probably the closest this place gets to hospitality.
